references.notes: Glasshouse service ventilator after the supplied G04/G10 brief; no measured maker drawing was consulted. 1.04 m sash, 48 mm frame, 420 mm curved rack, 78 mm pinion and 25 mm shaft are design assumptions. The rack is concentric with the hinge and rotates rigidly with the bottom rail. The horizontal shaft is below the LOWER transverse purlin, not the upper hinge purlin: this keeps the short rack at the bottom rail. The 18 degree opening is limited to the usable toothed quadrant travel.
other: User brief: Glasshouse vent sash with rack gear

review.seen: Beauty, clay, opposite, front and parts renders; closed and open states
review.weak: The shaft is carried under the lower purlin rather than the upper hinge purlin requested in the brief. Quadrant teeth are simplified trapezoids, not generated conjugate tooth forms; engagement is visual, not a mechanical contact simulation. Cast members meet by overlapping closed solids, without foundry fillets.
improve: Maker-derived tooth form and bearing castings [self-review]
Add a worm reduction for a genuinely self-locking operator [self-review]
